picks.title: Inaugurating The Era Of Super Intelligence
picks.excerpt: Executive order (signed Sept 29) directs all federal agencies to replace the terms 'Artificial Intelligence'/'AI' with 'Super Intelligence'/'SI' in official communications and policy documents, and tasks the Assistant to the President for Science and Technology with proposing a federal definition of SI and any further executive action needed.
picks.rationale: This is a primary document: a signed EO that changes federal AI terminology and orders a formal federal definition of SI. It is a new executive action beyond the earlier verbal agreements. Describe what it directs without characterizing it.

picks.title: Trump, top AI leaders agree to voluntary AI standards
picks.excerpt: After a White House meeting, President Trump and Speaker Mike Johnson announced that top AI executives signed a voluntary 'statement of principles' setting standards for reviewing AI systems, putting industry self-oversight at the center as pressure for safeguards grows.
picks.rationale: A concrete governance outcome: frontier labs signed voluntary review standards at the White House. This changes the ground rules for people who build on these models. Attribute the announcement to Trump and Johnson.

picks.title: Targeted consultation to support a better copyright environment for creativity and innovation (incl. copyright and generative AI)
picks.excerpt: European Commission opened a targeted consultation on a possible copyright initiative, with sections on copyright and generative AI licensing/enforcement and AI-generated imitations of performers.
picks.rationale: A primary EU document that opens formal input on genAI licensing, enforcement and performer imitation. It is directly relevant to creators and AI builders and adds a non-US policy view. og_image is empty, so ax-media needs an in-page visual.

picks.title: Tracking AI Chips: What Does It Cost?
picks.excerpt: CSET cost-benefit analysis of AI-chip location verification (ping-based verification vs physical inspections) for export-control enforcement against diversion.
picks.rationale: The geopolitics pick: a quantified analysis of how chip export controls could actually be enforced. It comes a day after the Nvidia-China loosening story and is an evidence-based take, not commentary. Attribute the cost estimates to CSET.

picks.title: AI researchers put out videos saying superintelligence is 'exactly as dangerous as it sounds'
picks.excerpt: Researchers from OpenAI, Google and Anthropic released public video interviews warning superintelligence is 'exactly as dangerous as it sounds' — a public-opinion push amid the Washington AI-safety fight.
picks.rationale: The public-opinion pick: researchers from rival labs taking their case directly to the public. Attribute the risk claims to the named researchers and keep the framing neutral.
